title: Pullback of a sheaf of modules along a morphism of schemes
statement:
Let $g:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with underlying continuous map $g$ and ring-sheaf map $g^\sharp:\mathcal O_Y\to g_*\mathcal O_X$, equivalently $g^{-1}\mathcal O_Y\to\mathcal O_X$. For a sheaf of $\mathcal O_Y$-modules $\mathcal G$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] (on the Zariski site of $Y$), the *pullback* $g^*\mathcal G$ is the sheaf of $\mathcal O_X$-modules

$$
g^*\mathcal G=\mathcal O_X\otimes_{g^{-1}\mathcal O_Y}g^{-1}\mathcal G,
$$

using the sheaf tensor product and change of rings [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], where $g^{-1}\mathcal G$ is the inverse image sheaf of abelian groups [def-weil-pbc-topological-inverse-image] (sheafification of $V\mapsto\varinjlim_{U\supseteq g(V)}\mathcal G(U)$) with its $g^{-1}\mathcal O_Y$-module structure. This is a functor $g^*:\mathrm{Mod}(\mathcal O_Y)\to\mathrm{Mod}(\mathcal O_X)$, left adjoint to the pushforward $g_*:\mathrm{Mod}(\mathcal O_X)\to\mathrm{Mod}(\mathcal O_Y)$, with $\mathrm{id}^*\cong\mathrm{id}$ and $(h\circ g)^*\cong g^*h^*$.

proof.text: For a module morphism u, use the canonical linear inverse-image map of [def-pc-topological-inverse-image-module], then sectionwise extension of scalars and module sheafification of [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Naturality is exactly SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsHom_naturality applied to inverseImageModuleMap. To prove tensorPullbackMap_id and tensorPullbackMap_comp, compare the presheaf morphisms sectionwise by PresheafOfModules.hom_ext. Unfold inverseImageModuleMap and homMk: the identity and composition laws of the abelian inverse-image functor and SheafOfModules.toSheaf give the corresponding section-map equalities. Functor.map_id and Functor.map_comp for extension of scalars and sheafification finish the two laws. This defines the displayed tensor formula as a functor on the module categories [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. The pushforward is the sectionwise one in Stacks 0095, with its action restricted along the structure-sheaf map; its tensor-formula adjunction remains the open second step.

proof.text: The morphism $g$ is in particular a morphism of ringed spaces [def-pc-scheme], and the pullback and pushforward of the preceding step are exactly $P_g$ and $g_*$ in [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. Its natural bijection $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O_X}(g^*\mathcal G,\mathcal F)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O_Y}(\mathcal G,g_*\mathcal F)$ is the adjunction claimed here. The named theorem is the missing tensor/restriction plus inverse-image/direct-image comparison, rather than an identification by notation with Mathlib's abstract left adjoint.

Apply [lem-pc-module-pullback-identity-composition] to the identity $X\to X$ and to the composable pair $g:X\to Y$, $h:Y\to Z$. Since its $P_a$ is the formula of this definition for each morphism $a$, the two natural isomorphisms there give $\mathrm{id}^*\cong\mathrm{id}$ and $(h\circ g)^*\cong g^*h^*$ with the source and target module categories required here.
